subject: integration
name: AI model standard (LLM_0_1)
summary: A definition of LLM_0_1: a respond group (risk 5) with respond, which streams a model's answer to a whole conversation, and models, which lists the models on offer. It names no provider or address; its description says the answerer is a language model the person connected, which sees everything sent: messages, tools offered, images. The group carries a daily token budget the browser counts from what a provider reports, or the most the request allows; the definition cannot check a report or an answer. Level 4 with privacy: the row connects to nothing. Judged here by its publisher.
